# T.10 — CaseFileV2 header receipt
#
# Generated by: dsfb-gpu-debug-core::casefile_v2 at T.10.
# Hardware:     host-only.
# Date:         2026-05-15.
# Scope:        T.10 minimal CaseFileV2 header receipt only.
#               NO full episode transcript.
#               NO Atlas dispatch body.
#               NO registry_hash_v2 binding.

================================================================
CaseFileV2Header schema
================================================================

  Domain separator:   DSFB-GPU-ATLAS:CASEFILE-V2-HEADER:v1\0
  Schema variant:     HeaderOnlyT10 (the only variant at T.10)
  Header hash policy: sha256( domain
                            || schema.as_str()
                            || corpus_hash_v1 (32 bytes)
                            || corpus_stage.as_str()
                            || detector_profile.name()
                            || detector_profile.active_detector_count() (u32 BE)
                            || detector_registry_hash (32 bytes)
                            || atlas_algebra_status.as_str()
                            || semantic_non_bypass (1 byte) )

Fields (panel-locked at T.10):
  - schema: CaseFileV2Schema     (HeaderOnlyT10)
  - corpus_hash_v1: [u8; 32]     (from T.10 freeze)
  - corpus_stage: CorpusStage    (FrozenT10 at T.10)
  - detector_profile: DetectorProfile
  - detector_registry_hash: [u8; 32]  (per-profile)
  - atlas_algebra_status: AtlasAlgebraStatus  (S1_1TypeSurfaceOnly)
  - semantic_non_bypass: bool    (MUST be true)

================================================================
Verifier rules
================================================================

verify_casefile_v2_header rejects:
  - ZeroCorpusHash          (corpus_hash_v1 == [0; 32])
  - SemanticNonBypassFalse  (semantic_non_bypass == false)
  - CorpusStagePreFreeze    (corpus_stage == InternalAuditPreFreeze)

A T.10 receipt MUST declare corpus_stage = FrozenT10 and
semantic_non_bypass = true.

================================================================
Receipt hashes for each detector profile (corpus_stage=FrozenT10,
algebra=S1_1TypeSurfaceOnly, semantic_non_bypass=true,
corpus_hash_v1=35c2...4b7)
================================================================

  casefile_v2_header_hash (D16)  = bc21d6ed3d22dd8e1330b84e31b91fed07516714fbc295c3617c5a73c75bdfe1
  casefile_v2_header_hash (D64)  = 3360ec8ba3ab9297afb08b357685e7af54a3087d67f0e6b76a033a4332ad6ffe
  casefile_v2_header_hash (D128) = f2787ef3a8fdf85d2ac10cf41cdab73bfe49c7d11a04e2d7ca43d1d893a56d82
  casefile_v2_header_hash (D205) = c593bdb887ff045252f5a7ce9c26502c7b18c088c0ae77a0771a900c6087dfc4

The four hashes are pairwise distinct because each header
carries a different detector_profile name + active_detector_count
+ detector_registry_hash. Changing corpus_hash_v1 or
semantic_non_bypass changes the header hash for every profile.

================================================================
Why this exists
================================================================

The CaseFileV2 header is the T.10 receipt anchor. It is NOT the
final Atlas case-file hash — that lives in a future commit when
the CaseFileV2 body (episode transcripts, fusion-plane verdicts,
trial transcripts) lands.

At T.10 the header receipt is enough to:
  1. Pin the corpus identity (corpus_hash_v1) into a verifiable
     16-byte chain link.
  2. Record the detector ladder identity (which profile is in
     scope: D16/D64/D128/D205).
  3. Carry forward the S1.1 algebra status without claiming the
     S1.2 registry has been generated.
  4. Reaffirm the Semantic Non-Bypass Axiom on every receipt.

================================================================
Explicit non-claims
================================================================

  - The header does NOT carry registry_hash_v2. The
    `detector_registry_hash` field is the per-profile hash
    (D16/D64/D128/D205), not the future S1.2 Atlas registry.
  - The header does NOT carry a full episode transcript.
  - The header does NOT bind to a fusion-plane verdict.
  - The header does NOT carry an Atlas detector-activation plan.
  - The header does NOT publish or deposit anything.

================================================================
Closing statement
================================================================

T.10 introduces a single minimal receipt header type. It is the
gate that lets future Atlas case files chain back to the
T.10-frozen corpus identity without requiring those future
commits to re-implement the freeze. The header hash is the
audit anchor: any caller can recompute it from public inputs
and prove the receipt is bound to the canonical corpus.
